author: Bethesda Softworks

For heroes. For smugglers. For settlers. For pilots. For anyone who looks up at the galaxy and says, “That belongs to me.” Starfield is now available on PlayStation® 5 alongside its largest update yet. Explore the Settled Systems with the Free Lanes Update and Terran Armada story DLC today!
